title: UK & Poland Modes, Daily Map Quizzes, and Redesigned Result Dashboard
body:
- Added English Countydle (48 ceremonial counties of England) with an interactive antique map and deterministic local fact answering.
- Added daily 10-round Map Quizzes for London Boroughs (32) and Historic Counties of England (48), and upgraded US State Map Quiz and Map Border Hop (Powiaty & US States) into server-authoritative daily challenges.
- Added the Poland License Plates Quiz (fill-the-map challenge across all 380 Polish counties).
- Redesigned the end-of-game Result Dashboard with distribution histograms, Today & Monthly leaderboards, Q&A recaps, and Next Daily navigation, excluding in-progress sessions from leaderboards.
- Moved static RAG context fragments to a compact SQLite store and refactored backend gameplay, local KB, and stats services into focused modules.
